title: Binance Suffers Security Breach Affecting $6.3 Billion in Assets, Nearly $3 Billion Frozen
summary: Cryptocurrency giant Binance said on Thursday that a "security incident" on its platform has impacted about $6.3 billion worth of assets.
card_summary: Cryptocurrency giant Binance said on Thursday that a "security incident" on its platform has impacted about $6.3 billion worth of assets.

sections.context: This fits the broader data-exposure trend where follow-on abuse of leaked information is common.

email_summary: Cryptocurrency giant Binance said on Thursday that a "security incident" on its platform has impacted about $6.3 billion worth of assets. The world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange said nearly $3 billion of those assets have been frozen on-chain so far.
